attach.description: Requires a SCHEDULED or LOADING trip and 1–200 distinct existing shipment IDs. Every shipment must be RECEIVED or PREPARING, have no trip membership (including this trip), and match the trip's origin_city_id, destination_city_id and branch_id exactly. Both branch IDs may be null; null does not match an assigned branch. PREPARING is required for departure, not attachment. The trip driver is optional; if assigned, the driver must be active. Attachment atomically sets each shipment's assigned_driver_id to the trip's driver_id, including null, without changing shipment status; prior driver equality is not required. Domain conflicts return 409 with a safe reason message and no partial membership changes. A successful same-key, same-body retry replays the result; a fresh-key attempt to attach an existing member conflicts.

detach.description: Requires a SCHEDULED or LOADING trip and a shipment currently belonging to that trip, with the existing trip access and assignment permission. Detachment atomically clears the shipment's trip_id and assigned_driver_id, preserving shipment status. Wrong membership returns 404; a trip outside the loadable states returns 409.
